storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: Saudi Arabia is experiencing increased pressure from Houthi attacks targeting airports and energy facilities. The Iran-aligned Houthi militia has threatened to strike the Saudi energy giant Aramco following an evacuation notice issued by Saudi authorities for an oil facility in Yemen's capital. This situation raises questions about the potential success of a Saudi-led international military offensive against the Houthis.
